Measurement contract

A score is only useful when its method is inspectable.

  1. 01
    Freeze the evidence

    Version the cases, human labels, rubric, evaluator, and parameters.

  2. 02
    Swap presentation order

    Judge identical response pairs as AB and BA.

  3. 03
    Canonicalize verdicts

    Map FIRST and SECOND back to original A/B identities.

  4. 04
    Audit the failures

    Report uncertainty and inspect each flip instead of hiding it in an average.
